extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li; Yi Wang; Jiashuo Yu; Xiangyu Zeng; Yuhan Zhu; Haian Huang; Jianfei Gao; Kunchang Li; Yinan He; Chenting Wang; Yu Qiao; Yali Wang; Limin Wang
extraction.citeAs: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang. VideoChat-Flash: Hierarchical Compression for Long-Context Video Modeling. 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by curating and filtering consecutive video segments from existing open-source video datasets (Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData) to form long video sequences.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing open-source video datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData, along with short video captions and annotations from Panda-70M, CosMo, Ego4D-HCap, and HT-Step.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations, we directly utilize them as the event labels, while for others, we extract the major event from the caption using an LLM. Finally, we construct several types of long video QA pairs based on the video captions, event labels, and the timestamps of short video segments.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: instruction-tuning; video captioning; temporal grounding; event relation recognition; scene relation recognition; video event counting
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: For datasets lacking high-quality event-level annotations, the major event was extracted from the caption using an LLM to serve as the event label.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Most captions are refined using AI models to ensure richer and more detailed descriptions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Consecutive video segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence (more than 60s) are filtered from the datasets.
